title: Finite etale filtration and trace transfer for lower-shriek sheaves
statement: Let k be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], X a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] separated finite-type curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], j:U -> X an open immersion, r a prime, R = ULift(Z/rZ), and G a finite locally constant R-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] on U. Let v:V -> U be finite etale. Suppose v^*G [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] has a specified finite filtration W_0=0, W_n isomorphic to v^*G, with monic inclusions and each cokernel the constant R sheaf R on V. Suppose the unit G -> v_*v^*G [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] has a specified retraction. Assume all eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] for extension by zero of constant R from every open in every reduced separated finite-type k-curve of dimension at most one. Then all eight assertions hold for j_!G [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. No connectedness or degree hypothesis on v is needed after supplying the filtration and retraction.

proof.text: Apply filteredFiniteCoverLowerShriekTransfer_core to the supplied cover, filtration and constant-case hypothesis.
Apply filteredFiniteCoverLowerShriekTransfer_retract to the resulting assertions and the supplied unit retraction.

proof_origin: Composition of the compactification/filtration transfer and unit-retract descent, following Stacks 03SD.

theorem filteredFiniteCoverLowerShriekTransfer {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {X U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (G : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    [Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G] (v : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite v] [Etale v]
    (n : ℕ)
    (W : ℕ → Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))))
    (ι : ∀ i, W i ⟶ W (i + 1)) (hzero : IsZero (W 0))
    (hend : Nonempty (W n ≅
      (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj G))
    (hquot : ∀ i < n, Mono (ι i) ∧ Nonempty (cokernel (ι i) ≅
      (constantSheaf V.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))).obj
        (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))))
    (ρ : (Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj
      ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).obj G) ⟶ G)
    (hρ : (Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) v).unit.app G ≫ ρ = 𝟙 G)
    (hconstant : ∀ {Y T : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve g] [IsReduced Y]
      (a : T ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion a],
      IsCurve.Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) g
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) a).obj
          ((constantSheaf T.smallEtaleTopology
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))).obj
            (ModuleCat.of _ (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))))) :
    IsCurve.Assertions (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)) f
      ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) j).obj G)
